data.title: 诱宵美九 · 露天咖啡座露肩针织的私密笑靥
data.description: 高级街角的露天遮阳伞下，美九换上私服露肩米白软针织衫，双手轻托咖啡杯，眼波流转露出唯你独享的倾城笑意。
data.location: 欧式林荫道露天咖啡馆
data.action: 坐在铸铁雕花椅上，双手环抱瓷白拿铁杯，歪头凝视镜头，嘴角噙着宠溺俏皮的浅笑
data.lighting: 树影斑驳的柔和日光，咖啡杯升腾的细弱蒸汽透光晶莹
data.camera: 近景平视人像特写，背景精致法式街景大光圈虚化
data.promptProse: Miku Izayoi enjoys an intimate afternoon rendezvous at a quaint outdoor Parisian-style street cafe under dappled tree shade. Dressed casually in a cozy, slouchy off-the-shoulder cream knit sweater that reveals a smooth bare shoulder, she cradles a warm porcelain latte cup in both hands. Tilting her head playfully, her amber-violet eyes crinkle with affectionate mirth meant for her companion alone.
data.animaCaption: Cradling a hot cup of latte at an outdoor cafe, Miku tilts her head with an affectionate, private smile.
